grants.justification: Consent-gated public publication surface. RLS is enabled and policy collective_publication_read restricts anon reads to rows with status='published' AND consent_state='explicit'. Only the owner (via authenticated insert/update/delete policies) can publish. No write path for anon.

Public short-link resolution for the redirect worker, which calls with the anon key. SECURITY DEFINER: returns only the single matching active link's id and target_url; there is deliberately no SELECT grant or anon select policy on public.smart_links, so anon can never enumerate the link directory. The worker records the click from the returned link_id (append-only RLS insert on public.smart_link_clicks). Reserved, unknown, or inactive names return no row, which the worker serves as 404.
grants.reviewed_by: Naya Resolve (main seat), from the 21:4x post-merge verification finding (board 6352640082 / PR #2945 comment 6352605029)

grants.justification: Public booking-page read for anonymous visitors, by design: a booking link must resolve for a stranger. SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path=public, STABLE; revoke-all-on-function from public precedes the grant. Returns only the single matching ACTIVE page's public shape (page_id, owner_alias, title, duration_minutes, calendar_sync_state) with LIMIT 1 - no owner_id, no booking rows. There is no anon SELECT grant or anon policy on public.booking_pages, so anon cannot enumerate pages; an unknown or inactive slug returns no row.
grants.reviewed_by: Naya Resolve (booking author lane), per-grant audit of the migration bytes, kernel-red cure run 2026-10-23

grants.justification: Public availability read for the booking picker. SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path=public, STABLE; revoke-all precedes the grant. Returns only the availability windows (weekday, start_time, end_time, timezone) of the single ACTIVE page named by slug - the owner's own public offering, bounded by that page's window rows. Exposes no booking rows and no visitor data. There is no anon SELECT grant or anon policy on public.booking_availability.
grants.reviewed_by: Naya Resolve (booking author lane), per-grant audit of the migration bytes, kernel-red cure run 2026-10-23

grants.justification: Taken-slot read for the booking picker: what a visitor may learn is WHEN a page is busy, never WHO booked. SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path=public, STABLE; revoke-all precedes the grant. Returns only (starts_at, ends_at) of CONFIRMED bookings on the ACTIVE page overlapping the caller-supplied range - no visitor name, note, email hash, or booking id. There is no anon SELECT grant or anon policy on public.bookings, so this RPC is the whole of the anonymous surface for bookings.
grants.reviewed_by: Naya Resolve (booking author lane), per-grant audit of the migration bytes, kernel-red cure run 2026-10-23

grants.justification: Visitor self-cancel, token-gated by design. SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path=public; revoke-all precedes the grant. The booking's own cancel_token (unguessable uuid issued at booking time) is the whole credential: the single UPDATE flips one row only where id AND cancel_token match AND status='confirmed', and the function returns only a boolean. A wrong token changes nothing (row_count 0 -> false). No row data is returned, and there is no anon UPDATE policy or grant on public.bookings outside this RPC.
grants.reviewed_by: Naya Resolve (booking author lane), per-grant audit of the migration bytes, kernel-red cure run 2026-10-23

law: Anonymous-surface grants are fail-closed: any GRANT to anon/PUBLIC in supabase/migrations/ without a matching entry here fails CI (tools/safety_anon_grant_gate.py).
